en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a narrow valley town with a river or canal and a main road running along it, lined with multi‑storey houses typical of Central Europe. On the left foreground stands an ornate, exotic‑looking building with onion domes, patterned tiled roof, and a tall tower with elaborate arches and pinnacles, surrounded by trees and a formal garden. In the distance on a hilltop are the ruins of a castle overlooking the town. The scene is rural‑mountainous, with wooded hills enclosing the settlement. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image itself.
